name: grid-ball-voids
title: Ball grid array with empty positions
summary: Ball grid array (BGA, WLCSP) with empty positions: rows × columns solder balls less those inside up to 16 rectangular cut-outs (void_<k>_x, _y, _length, _width), under an epoxy body; top edges rounded, A1 dimple (rows, columns, pitch, row_pitch, body_length, body_width, body_height, contact_diameter, contact_height, edge_round, mark_radius, mark_depth, void_1…16).
provenance: Original work: the in-code grid builder's construction (crates/solidcraft-integration/src/models/grid.rs, retired with these files) made parametric in its counts, saved through SolidCraft's commands by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` at a 4 × 5 grid of 0.8 mm on a 5 × 4 mm body, rows B–C and columns 2–4 empty; the grid generator gives every parameter its value. Matrix, pitch, body and contact sizes are the generator's (the grid starter rows: JEDEC fine-pitch BGA conventions, typical values); land thickness, edge round and A1 dimple are estimated. No vendor drawing or EDA/CAD library data copied.
